scenes.purpose: Say what the deed set out to do, in plain words
script: For Deed One, I wanted the simplest useful thing on Solana: a page that shows what's in a wallet and lets you send some of it.
I called it the easy one.

scenes.purpose: The analogy: a wallet is a key ring, the coins are on a public ledger
script: Here's the idea that makes the rest click.
Your wallet doesn't hold your coins.
The coins sit on a public ledger that anyone can read, and your key only proves which entries are yours.
So a dashboard is a window onto that ledger, plus a way to ask the key ring to sign.

scenes.purpose: Connect the test wallet on devnet
script: Devnet is Solana's practice field: same rules, play money.
Connecting shares only the public address.
There's the SOL balance and two test tokens.

scenes.purpose: Replay the saved terminal output of one transfer
script: First transfer: one hundredth of a SOL.
The wallet signs it and devnet confirms it.
